answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a quartz deposit buried under its identity: one stake, one voice. A Sybil attacker trying to flood the market with fake agents faces a dune that keeps growing — each new identity demands another locked deposit, so the cost rises linearly with every sock puppet. Honest agents earn the stake back plus a jade seal of good standing once they behave; proven cheaters forfeit theirs, so faking identities stops paying and real work wins.
